plan.fit_summary: Tier A fit: DACHSER is a global logistics provider headquartered in Germany whose portfolio includes Food Logistics Services and Contract Logistics Services, matching ColdTrace's temperature-controlled logistics ICP [2].

who.why: Owns the food logistics business line where temperature monitoring and audit documentation are operationally critical [2].

who.role: Head of Corporate Compliance / Quality Management
who.why: DACHSER runs a compliance reporting system under 'Integrity in Logistics', so audit-ready temperature records fall in this remit [4].

plan.hook: DACHSER's latest results announcement states that Food Logistics continues to expand [6]. Growth in temperature-controlled flows usually means more audit documentation per shipment — the manual part of that is what ColdTrace eliminates.
plan.channel: Phone call or LinkedIn message as first touch, not cold email: DACHSER is headquartered in Germany [2], and German law (UWG § 7) requires prior consent for B2B email. Concrete call reason: how the expanding Food Logistics business [6] handles temperature documentation for audits. Use the email draft only after consent, or send it as a physical letter. Not legal advice.
avoid: Do not cite headcount or revenue figures: the headcount data in the source is clearly unreliable [2] and the revenue figure is truncated mid-sentence [6].
Do not claim specific certifications (e.g. IFS, GDP, HACCP) or audit obligations — none appear in the sources, so certification pressure cannot be evidenced.
Do not name or guess individual people; address roles only.
questions: How do you currently document temperature compliance across your food logistics transports and warehouses, and how much manual effort goes into preparing audit reports?

draft.subject: food logistics wachstum
draft.body:
Ihre Food-Logistik-Sparte expandiert laut der aktuellen Ergebnismeldung von DACHSER weiter [6]. Mit wachsenden temperaturgeführten Transport- und Lagerflüssen steigt erfahrungsgemäß der Aufwand für die Temperaturdokumentation bei Audits – oft manuell und zeitintensiv. Genau dort setzen wir mit drahtlosen Temperatursensoren und automatisch erstellten Auditberichten an. Ist das ein Thema, das Sie derzeit betrachten?

[Sender]
